source: OPM Flow Reference Manual (2026-04) Revision: Rev-0

3.1_introduction.description: The OPM Flow manual uses extensive cross-referencing for efficient navigation. Key navigation features include footer links (Table of Contents, Keyword Index), alphabetic keyword listing with color coding (green=implemented, orange=recognized but not implemented, red=not implemented), clickable section names, and PDF bookmarks.

components: Section header with keyword name in capital letters and brief description
Keyword Table Section showing status across OPM Flow sections

color_coding.green: Keyword available in this section and mostly/fully implemented
color_coding.gray: Keyword cannot be used in this section
color_coding.orange: Keyword partially implemented (recognized but function ignored)
color_coding.red: Available in commercial simulator but not implemented in OPM Flow - causes errors/abort if used

3.3_multi_section_keywords.concept: Keywords usable in multiple sections are defined only once in the first available section to avoid duplication
3.3_multi_section_keywords.example: ADD keyword - defined in GRID section, with brief descriptions + links in EDIT, PROPS, REGIONS, SOLUTION sections
3.3_multi_section_keywords.mechanism: Keyword Table Section shows green cells for available sections, gray for unavailable. Full description in first section; other sections reference it.

general_rules: All keywords must be in capital case
Keywords must start in column one
Keywords not in column one are not recognized

3.4.1_comment_format.placement: Anywhere in the file, or after '/' terminating a record
examples:
--
-- MAX MAX RSVD TVDP TVDP
-- EQLNUM DEPTH NODES TABLE NODES
EQLDIMS
9 1* 20 1* 1* /

3.4.2_activation_format.syntax: Keyword alone on a line (no parameters)
3.4.2_activation_format.purpose: Invoke a feature or switch processing on/off
3.4.2_activation_format.applicable_sections: Primarily RUNSPEC (e.g., GAS, OIL, WATER), but can appear in other sections

3.4.3_vector_row_format.syntax: Keyword followed by vector of parameters on separate line(s); each line = one data set terminated by '/'
3.4.3_vector_row_format.required_fields: Vector parameters as defined per keyword
3.4.3_vector_row_format.optional_fields: Default values indicated in parameter table
3.4.3_vector_row_format.termination: Each data set line terminated by '/'
examples:
ROCK
3566.9 5.0E-06 / ROCK COMPRESSIBILITY REGION 1
3966.9 5.5E-06 / ROCK COMPRESSIBILITY REGION 2
4566.9 6.0E-06 / ROCK COMPRESSIBILITY REGION 3
3.4.3_vector_row_format.documentation_structure: Description + parameter table (No., Name, Description, Default per unit system) + examples
3.4.3_vector_row_format.notes: No terminating '/' for the keyword itself (only per data set)

3.4.4_vector_columnar_format.syntax: Keyword followed by columnar vector - each parameter in separate column, rows = data points
3.4.4_vector_columnar_format.required_fields: Columnar parameters as defined per keyword
3.4.4_vector_columnar_format.termination: Each table terminated by '/'; no '/' for keyword
examples:
SWFN
-- SWAT KRW PCOW
-- FRAC FRAC PSIA
0.15 0.00000 1*
0.30 0.00050 1*
...
1.00 0.52200 1* / TABLE NO. 1
3.4.4_vector_columnar_format.documentation_structure: Description + parameter table (No., Name, Description, Default per unit system) + notes + examples
3.4.4_vector_columnar_format.notes: Followed by NTSFUN tables (from TABDIMS); each table min 2 rows, max NSSFUN rows
3.4.4_vector_columnar_format.applicable_sections: PROPS (SWFN, SOF*, SGF*, etc.), PVT tables

3.4.5_array_format.syntax: Keyword followed by full array of values (NX x NY x NZ entries); uses BOX to define sub-area
3.4.5_array_format.required_fields: Complete array matching grid dimensions (or BOX-defined region)
3.4.5_array_format.documentation_structure: Description + parameter table (No., Name, Description, Default per unit system) + notes + examples
3.4.5_array_format.notes: Repeat counts allowed; number of entries must match NX x NY x NZ (or BOX region)
3.4.5_array_format.applicable_sections: GRID (PORO, PERMX, PERMY, PERMZ, DX, DY, DZ, TOPS, DEPTH), EDIT, PROPS, REGIONS, SOLUTION

3.5_input_file_structure.description: OPM Flow input deck separated into sections (similar to ECLIPSE 100) to avoid errors. Sections must appear in order.

sections.name: RUNSPEC
sections.purpose: Defines key simulator parameters: model dimensions, phases present (oil/gas/water), number of tables and max rows, max groups/wells/completions, options to invoke

sections.name: GRID
sections.purpose: Defines basic grid properties: structure, faults, static rock properties (porosity, permeability). Calculates pore volumes (PORV) and transmissibilities (TRANX, TRANY, TRANZ, NNC)

sections.name: EDIT
sections.purpose: Allows editing of properties calculated in GRID section (PORV, TRANX, etc.)

sections.name: PROPS
sections.purpose: Defines fluid properties for all phases (viscosity, formation volume factor) and rock flow properties (relative permeability, capillary pressure)

sections.name: REGIONS
sections.purpose: Defines regions for reporting and allocation of fluid/rock properties from PROPS section throughout model

sections.name: SOLUTION
sections.purpose: Defines initialization parameters: fluid contacts, reservoir pressures. Reports initial in-place volumes and average pressures for regions

sections.name: SUMMARY
sections.purpose: Defines summary vectors vs time for output files (field/group/well production, injection, grid block properties). Nearly always included for results.

sections.name: SCHEDULE
sections.purpose: Defines time-dependent data: field/group/well parameters, targets/constraints, numerical controls, operating schedule, reporting requirements

notes: SUMMARY is optional but nearly always included for production/injection profiles
OPM ResInsight can cross-plot grid block properties vs time, reducing need to export grid block data to SUMMARY

format_type_summary.COMMENT: Free text, '--' prefix, anywhere in file
format_type_summary.ACTIVATION: Keyword only, no parameters, switches features on/off
format_type_summary.VECTOR_ROW: Row-wise parameters, one data set per line, '/' per line
format_type_summary.VECTOR_COLUMNAR: Column-wise parameters, tabular data, '/' per table
format_type_summary.ARRAY: Full grid array (NX*NY*NZ values), '/' terminates keyword, uses BOX for sub-regions
